summary: Colour-coded gauge sub-window: one hidden background image plus green/orange/red fill panes.
evidence: Ui_ColorGaugeWindow_InitPanes (0x0045ECEC) binds 'gauge_base' and caches 'gauge_green'/'gauge_orange'/'gauge_red'; the batch base 'Ui_AnimRef' is a false positive of Ui_AnimRef_Bind, the ctor itself only calls the shared layout base drN (0x001A6520).

fields.name: baseAnim
fields.evidence: Ui_AnimRef_Bind(&self->f_4c, layout, 'gauge_base', 0) then Ui_AnimRef_ResetPanes(&self->f_4c, 0) hides the background - an embedded animation reference.

fields.name: greenPane
fields.evidence: layout vtable +0x2C lookup of 'gauge_green' stored at +0x9C; returned pane played for the green fill.

fields.name: orangePane
fields.evidence: layout vtable +0x2C lookup of 'gauge_orange' stored at +0xA0.

fields.name: redPane
fields.evidence: layout vtable +0x2C lookup of 'gauge_red' stored at +0xA4.

fields.name: vtable

summary: Small holder object that owns two memories windows (a 0x3DF4-byte one and a 0x124-byte one).
evidence: Ui_DualWindow_Ctor (0x003055F8) stores vtable 0x00762CD8, allocates 0x3DF4 and 0x124 bytes, runs Ui_MemoriesWindow_Ctor/Ui_MemoriesWindow_CtorBase and stores the two child pointers; the alternate dtor at 0x00310C90 releases slots +0xC/+0x10 instead of +8/+0xC.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: ctor stores 0x00762CD8 at offset 0 (`str r0,[r5]`); no base ctor is called, so this is the class vtable.

fields.name: windowA
fields.evidence: Mem_AllocAligned_2(0x3DF4) then Ui_MemoriesWindow_Ctor, Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, stored at +8, then `iVar3->f_94 = 1` and vtable +0x24 start call.

fields.name: windowB
fields.evidence: second allocate (0x124 bytes) + Ui_MemoriesWindow_CtorBase stored at +12 and started the same way.

fields.name: maybe_windowC
fields.evidence: only the template-copy destructor 0x00310C90 releases the pointer at +0x10 (as self[4]); no ctor in the batch fills it.

summary: Dungeon-skill page window: shows the 'win_dungeon_skill' layout and animates the current page's progress.
evidence: Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_InitLayout (0x004080F0) binds 'win_dungeon_skill'; SetPagePercent (0x004082C4) stores pageMode-1 at +0x11C and converts +0x124 to a 0..1 fraction (multiplier 0x3C23D70A = 0.01f).

fields.name: maybe_layoutObject
fields.evidence: Teardown calls the vtable slot +0x2C of the object pointed to by +0x98 (`(*self->f_98->f_2c)()`), the layout 'find pane' slot; the object itself is created elsewhere.

fields.name: pageIndex
fields.evidence: SetPagePercent stores pageMode-1 here (0 when pageMode==1) before updating the page animation.

fields.name: pagePercent
fields.evidence: VectorSignedToFloat(self->f_124) is multiplied by 0x3C23D70A (0.01f), so this is an integer percent driving the page animation.

fields.name: maybe_sectionWidget
fields.evidence: Ui_Widget_FindPaneAndNotify(self, self+0x128, 'win_dungeon_skill', 0) makes this embedded widget the receiver of the bound pane; func_0029126C(self+0x128, 1) shows it and Ui_CreditWindow_TeardownSections(self+0x128) tears its animation sections down.

summary: Button/key prompt window showing a text label ('p1_txt_chage') and a Y-button icon ('p1_icon_key_y').
evidence: Ui_KeyPromptWindow_InitPanes (0x003188A0) binds 'p1_txt_chage' and 'p1_icon_key_y' into +0x20/+0x24; SetIconVisible (0x00318920) copies a visible byte to +4 and the signed state at +0x1C into bit 0 of the parts' +0x44 draw flag.

fields.name: textId
fields.evidence: `func_003828B8(self, 'p1_txt_chage', (u32)self->f_10 << 16, layout)` - the 16-bit value is moved into the high half of the text/pane id argument.

fields.name: maybe_iconVisible
fields.evidence: loaded with `ldrsb r1,[r4,#0x1c]` (a signed byte), then written into bit 0 of the +0x44 draw flag of both parts; the parameter stored at +4 is the new value, so +0x1C is the applied icon visibility state.

fields.name: textPart
fields.evidence: layout vtable +0x2C lookup of 'p1_txt_chage' stored here; its +0x44 draw flag is updated by SetIconVisible.

fields.name: iconPart
fields.evidence: layout vtable +0x2C lookup of 'p1_icon_key_y' stored here; its +0x44 draw flag is updated by SetIconVisible.

summary: Small plate sub-window with a left text row and two swap animations (plate_mini_in / plate_mini_out).
evidence: Ui_MiniPlateWindow_InitPanes (0x003ABAD8) passes the embedded layout reference at +0x98 to Ui_Window_CollectNamedPane ('txt_left') and Ui_AnimRef_Bind ('plate_mini_in'/'plate_mini_out'); SelectPlate (0x003ABB98) switches between those two anim refs.

fields.name: layoutRef
fields.evidence: `iVar1 = self + 0x98` (asm `add r5,r0,#0x98`) is passed as the layout argument to Ui_Window_CollectNamedPane and Ui_AnimRef_Bind; the thunk at 0x003ABB30 calls *(self+0x98)->vt[+0x2C], so an embedded layout-reference object with a vtable starts here.

fields.name: maybe_paneBinder
fields.evidence: `Ui_Window_CollectNamedPane(self + 0xD4, name, 0, self + 0x98)` - address of an embedded pane-array header (pointer at +8, capacity +0xC, count +0x10) used as the collector's self.

fields.name: inAnim
fields.evidence: Ui_AnimRef_Bind(self + 0x154, layout, 'plate_mini_in', 0); SelectPlate resets this anim ref when the text is not a control code and sets the +0x1F4 state byte.

fields.name: outAnim
fields.evidence: Ui_AnimRef_Bind(self + 0x1A4, layout, 'plate_mini_out', 0); SelectPlate resets this anim ref for the control-code fallback.

summary: Movie subtitle text window bound to the 'win_movie_txt' layout pane.
evidence: Ui_MovieTextWindow_InitPanes (0x003A9C84) binds 'win_movie_txt' through Ui_Widget_FindPaneAndNotify(self, self+0x138, ...), registers the node at +0x11C and links +0x150; the dtor (0x003A9D5C) stores vtable 0x00759388 via the base dtor.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: the dtor writes 0x00759388 through `*(u32*)(Ui_Object_DtorBase() - 0x1C)`; the ctor's offset-0 store is `*param_1 = param_2` in the damaged dtor pseudo-C.

fields.name: maybe_registeredNode
fields.evidence: `func_00123594(self, self + 0x11C)` registers an embedded list node at this address with the parent object (the same insert helper used for window child lists).

fields.name: maybe_paneSender
fields.evidence: `Ui_Widget_FindPaneAndNotify(self, self + 0x138, 'win_movie_txt', 0)` uses this embedded object as the pane receiver; InitPanes then writes param_3 to param_1[0x4E] (= +0x138).

fields.name: maybe_linkNode
fields.evidence: `func_001235A4(self + 300, self + 300, self + 0x150)` links the embedded node at +0x150; func_001235A4 is the list-link counterpart of func_00123594.

fields.name: position1Anim

fields.name: position2Anim
